name: Brida
looks: the round-faced cook with flour on her apron
background: Brida has fed the manor household for twenty years and comes to the inn on her one free evening a week to be served for once.
temperament: Unflappable and patient, mothering in a gruff way; she is slow to warm to strangers.
speech: Plain country speech, blunt opinions on food, laughs from the belly.
quirks: Judges the inn's bread aloud; carries her own salt; hums while she waits; will throw a dart or two but never plays for coin.
secret: She has been quietly feeding a runaway kitchen boy hiding in the manor stables.
goal: Sit somewhere warm, have someone else pour the ale, and hear the gossip from the manor's side of the valley, from the one or two people she chooses to trust.
